No option can be put forward yet because the model could not test your “monthly churn under 4%” limit.

- The price comparison itself held up under the model’s tested perturbations, but that is not evidence that any option keeps churn below 4%.
- The result is most sensitive to Pro subscriber count; its value is an Olumi estimate, not user-provided evidence. Other-plan MRR, Pro conversions and churn are also machine-authored estimates.
- The model also assumed that higher MRR is the objective, rather than verifying whether £20k/month is a threshold to reach within 12 months.
